formattedAddress: No. 58號, Lane 30, Section 4, Xinyi Rd, Zhu'an Village, Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106

text.text: Great local cuisine restaurant with a bit of a different flare to local delicacies. Great choices and everything was delicious. Highly recommended. Always nice to come with more people because then one can try a lot of dishes.

text.text: A local friend brought us here to this quaint izakaya store tucked away from the main roads. Serves up great food and drinks (I don't drink alcohol but my companions very much enjoyed the highball and made 3 repeated orders each). Service is friendly and personable (as with the usual Taiwanese culture). Interior design exudes an element of old charm and it's a vibe. Highly recommend visiting!

text.text:
Been coming to this establishment for years and have always been super impressed with the quality of the food. If I can give this place a 6 out of 5 star, I would. It’s that good.

Everything dish is created to overwhelm your taste buds with delicious explosion of flavors. Everything goes perfectly with beer. I like everything on the menu, but if I really had to choose these are my go to dishes:
腐乳鹹酥雞 (Fried chicken)
主廚雞油飯 (chicken rice)
地方花椒麵 (spicy noodles)
桔醬豬五花 （grilled pork belly marinated in home-made honey sauce)
串烤牛小排 (grilled boneless beef rib)
厚切黃金脆薯 (fried potato wedges)

The charming old school decor creates a warm, cozy dining experience; perfect for informal gathering with friends and breaking ice on hot new dates.

The service staff is energetic and enthusiastic; always ready to make your dining experience unforgettable.

As this restaurant is super popular, you should call at least 3 days in advance to make reservation on weekdays, and 1 week in advance on weekends.
